previous_description: Specifies the legal license under which the API is provided, including license name and URL to full terms. Clarifies usage rights for API consumers.
definition: A metadata object, nested under an API's Info object, that identifies by name the legal license governing use of the API and optionally gives a URL to the full license text. It describes terms of use for the API contract itself, not the license of the implementing source code.

distinguish_from.when: the element is the overall API metadata block (title, version, description, termsOfService) rather than only the license name and URL inside it.
the URL points to guides, wikis or reference docs that explain the API rather than to the legal license terms.
the information identifies who owns or supports the API (name, email, URL) rather than the legal terms under which it may be used.

code_evidence: an info.license block with name (e.g. 'Apache 2.0', 'MIT') and url fields in an openapi.yaml/openapi.json file
a framework OpenAPI config call setting license metadata, e.g. springdoc new License().name("Apache 2.0").url(...), FastAPI(license_info={...}) or swagger-jsdoc definition.info.license
an @OpenAPIDefinition(info = @Info(license = @License(name=..., url=...))) or equivalent annotation on an application or config class

attribute_descriptions.name: url
attribute_descriptions.description: Absolute URL (OpenAPI 3.0 requires URL format) pointing to the full text of the license; set it whenever the license terms are published at a resolvable location.

notes: The required OpenAPI 'name' field is not listed as an attribute; it is presumably carried by the element's generic name, which should be stated explicitly. The outgoing associated-with link to api.openapidocument duplicates the path via api.info aggregation and may be redundant.
